recall.minute: Agents run an LLM in a loop: perceive, reason, act with tools, observe, update memory, until done or limits hit. Autonomy spectrum: single call → workflow → router → agent → multi-agent; prefer the simplest. Architecture: perception, memory (short-term context; long-term vector/database store), planning (decompose, re-plan), tools (function calls). ReAct is the controller: search France → ~68M, calculator 68 × 2 → 136, finish; cap steps. Multi-agent: orchestrator–workers (research → draft → check), critics, debate, hand-offs; more cost, cascading errors. Data agents: text-to-SQL/pandas, validate read-only, execute, retry on errors (Delhi 350; Feb average 113.3; DELETE blocked). Agentic RAG: decide when/what to retrieve, rewrite queries, multi-hop (maker → founder). Safeguards: step/budget limits, loop detection, schema validation, sandbox, least privilege, human approval for risky actions, treat tool outputs as untrusted, logging and evaluation; 0.97¹⁰ ≈ 0.74.
